sentence: This project builds a robotic teaching assistant to help nursing instructors train nurses in routine nursing procedures.
This project studies how the quantum nature of light can control the interaction between molecules and light.
This project builds a recirculating seawater system to study the reproduction, development and behavior of local marine species.
This project develops data-driven artificial intelligence approaches for the design of engineered systems.
This project studies how entangled states can be created, manipulated and characterized in quantum networks.
This project studies how nanoparticle drug delivery systems reach and protect sensitive structures within the inner ear.
This project develops fully polymeric hydrogels that have antifreezing properties and mechanical strength at subzero temperatures.
This project builds a helium liquefaction system for liquid helium used in research on quantum materials.
This project develops a computer architecture that realizes matrix multiplication in the analog domain to improve the energy efficiency of machine learning systems.
This project uses artificial intelligence to obtain sleep health information from rural and aging adults who do not have regular access to sleep specialists.
This project develops laser cooling in mirror coatings to control thermal distortion and lower thermal noise in gravitational-wave detectors.
This project studies the photo-degradation products of ultraviolet filters in commercial sunscreens exposed to sunlight.
This project studies coastal oceanography, including marine bacteria, kelp forest ecology and the ecophysiology of corals.
This project studies how quarks and gluons are distributed inside hadrons and how they interact through the strong nuclear force.
This project develops smart and sustainable technologies for energy in buildings.
This project studies how tyrosine phosphorylation and tyrosine kinase proteins regulate glucose movement into cells.
